detail: Utilize modular cells to precompute transfer, stitching multiple unit cells together and warping them to approximate scene geometry [S1, unofficial].

The claim is a direct paraphrase of the content found in Source [S1] passages, specifically the sentence: 'Multiple of these unit cells are stitched together and warped to approximate scene geometry. Radiance is then propagated first to cell borders which act as interfaces and then to the neighboring cells using precomputed models.' The source explicitly attributes this method to Mitchel et al. and confirms all factual elements mentioned in the claim.
